imu_frame.note: levelled body frame: after the legs-neutral stance settles, rotate the phone's readings by the smallest rotation that makes the gravity it measures read +z (so x stays toward the nose, y to the robot's left); accel is accelerationIncludingGravity in m/s^2, gyro in rad/s; IMU_SIGN must be [1, 1, 1] for this policy

cmd_yaw.sign: positive when the target is counter-clockwise of where the camera points seen from above, i.e. turn left

cmd_forward.scale: +1 walks camera first toward the target at 5 cm/s, -1 backs away nose first at 3 cm/s, 0 stands and turns to face it; the sign picks the gait, and a wide heading turns first

action_filter.meaning: each tick, sent = previous sent + alpha x (net output - previous sent), on the squashed action, from the first output on; alpha is 'forward' while cmd_forward is above 0, else 'otherwise'; prev_action_N reads the sent action

cmd_pitch.scale: -1 holds the body 20 degrees flatter than its resting stance, +1 6 degrees taller; only while standing (speed 0)
